description: Design and implementation of a prototype focused on improving security in IoT environments. Developed backend services with Node.js, containerization with Docker, and designed secure network architectures.
Developed a smart web platform for monitoring soil parameters (nitrogen, pH, humidity) by integrating IoT devices. Implemented Machine Learning models for automatic fertilization recommendations.
Installation and configuration of residential networks, including structured cabling, router configuration, and connectivity troubleshooting (LAN/Wi-Fi).
Comprehensive training with a strong focus on mobile development (React Native) and software architecture. Developed mobile applications applying API consumption and mobile-first principles.
